items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: I don't think he messed with Cliff Jackson, though.

ctx.x: I know that there would be sometimes different ideas about time and so on, I guess.
Yeah, but the piano player would be all right, you know what I mean... I don't think he messed with Cliff Jackson, though.
No, I liked Zutty a lot, but of course, I didn't have to work with him or anything.
